generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every essay, report and project you write rests on the sources behind it. An argument is only as sound as the search that found them: wide enough to be fair to the evidence, sharp enough to be useful, and built on sources you judged rather than simply collected. Treat what follows as being about your own searches and reading, not about study in the abstract.

The same habit runs through professional practice. Wherever you are asked to find out what is known, weigh its quality, and act on the best of it, the people who do it well are the ones who search widely, judge carefully, and can stand behind their choices. The craft you build here is one you keep long after you graduate.
